title: Detailed crystal ball
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='globeGrad' cx='38%' cy='32%' r='72%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8fbff'/>
      <stop offset='35%' stop-color='#8fd8f0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#3a8fd0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1c4f8a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='swirlGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0e6ff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#b48ce8' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a4fd0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='baseGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd76e'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e0a020'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a86e08'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='rimGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3c4'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#f0b830'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c07c10'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- crystal ball globe -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='34' fill='url(#globeGrad)'/>
  <!-- inner mystic swirls -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='40' rx='20' ry='12' fill='url(#swirlGrad)' transform='rotate(-25 46 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='50' rx='14' ry='8' fill='url(#swirlGrad)' transform='rotate(30 54 50)'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='48' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='58' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- glossy highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-30 38 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='24' rx='4.5' ry='2.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.45' transform='rotate(-30 63 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='64' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#bff0ff' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(35 64 64)'/>

  <!-- bottom glow reflection -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='18' ry='6' fill='#d8f6ff' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- gold rim ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='7' fill='url(#rimGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#ffe89a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- pedimental base -->
  <path d='M34 74 Q32 82 28 88 L72 88 Q68 82 66 74 Z' fill='url(#baseGrad)'/>
  <path d='M34 74 Q32 82 28 88 L38 88 Q40 82 41 74 Z' fill='#ffe89a' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='24' ry='5' fill='#8a5a06'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='22' ry='3.4' fill='#c98a12'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='14' ry='2' fill='#ffe089' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
